Create a venny summary data.frame

Source: R/utils.R
venn_summary.Rd

A data.frame consists of each combination of the input sets.

Usage

venn_summary(data = list(), show_elements = FALSE)

Arguments

data

A named list contains 2 ~ 26 sets of elements. For example, list(set1 = 1:5, set2 = 3:7).

show_elements

Logical (default: FALSE). List out the elements of each zone in the dataframe.

Value

A data frame contains necessary information for subsequent inferences and plotting.

Examples

venn_summary(LGL23$DEGs)
#> $table
#>      A B C D subset n_elements percentage
#> A    1 0 0 0      A          3        0.1
#> B    0 1 0 0      B       1070       20.0
#> AB   1 1 0 0     AB         16        0.3
#> C    0 0 1 0      C        264        4.9
#> AC   1 0 1 0     AC          1        0.0
#> BC   0 1 1 0     BC         42        0.8
#> ABC  1 1 1 0    ABC          0        0.0
#> D    0 0 0 1      D       2282       42.8
#> AD   1 0 0 1     AD          0        0.0
#> BD   0 1 0 1     BD        909       17.0
#> ABD  1 1 0 1    ABD         10        0.2
#> CD   0 0 1 1     CD        494        9.3
#> ACD  1 0 1 1    ACD          2        0.0
#> BCD  0 1 1 1    BCD        240        4.5
#> ABCD 1 1 1 1   ABCD          4        0.1
#> 
#> $set_names_ref
#>        orig_setnames dummy_setnames

#> 2 KO_high vs KO_mock              B
#> 3 WT_mock vs KO_mock              C
#> 4 OE_mock vs KO_mock              D
